Bijoy Dibosh at Foring
2018-12-11T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/lifestyle/check-it-out/news/bijoy-dibosh-foring-1671730

For the upcoming Victory Day celebrations on 16 December, fashion house Foring is all set and ready with their new collections. Their showrooms are already decorated to fit the celebratory ambience.

Saris, panjabis, shalwar-kameezs, fatuas, t-shirts etc. are sporting embroidery, applique, block prints, tie-dye and much more on base colours like red and green, along with sky blue, maroon, and grey.

Matching clothing sets for children are also available

Locations: 25/11 Tajmahal Road, Mohammadpur; 9 Rankin Street, Wari; Flat 2, Rabindra Sarani, Sector 7, Uttara; Romena Afaz Bhaban, Bogura.

For more information, please visit https://www.facebook.com/Foring-Ltd-418926821602453 or http://www.foringbd.com
